summary: A glass Card titled This week holding three card-less Stat blocks in a responsive grid: leads with a hint, reply rate with a unit, trend and hint, and booked calls with a positive trend.
use: Plain statistics inside an existing card or panel, with no nested box, instead of several KpiCards.
spec: `<Card material="glass" title="This week" headingLevel={3} class="stats-card">` with `max-width: 640px`
`<Stat label="Leads this week" value="128" hint="12 more than last week" />`
`<Stat label="Reply rate" value="18" unit="%" trend={-2.4} hint="Goal: 25%" />`
The Stats sit in an auto-fit grid, `minmax(150px, 1fr)`, `gap: var(--ca-space-5)`
